reviewed_high_risk.rationale: RA2: /stackvox-install and /stackvox-upgrade start the local stackvox text-to-speech daemon with nohup, which is the documented purpose of those commands. TM1: /stackvox-uninstall deletes only the stackvox model cache (after asking the user) and the plugin's own check stamp.

RA2: the SessionStart hook boots the local stackvox daemon, and the Codex hook scripts re-run themselves in the background because Codex does not support async hooks. SC2: check-install.sh reads the stackvox version from the PyPI JSON API at most once a week to suggest /stackvox-upgrade; nothing it fetches is executed.
